tiers.notes: Experience-anchored: no prior experience of the practice assumed. May have met it in passing but has not done it deliberately. Teach from first principles. Cognitive demand: recognition, recall, description, guided application. indicativeLevels are NOT progression — self-judged beginners arrive from many levels; an introductory tier may hold L3, L4, L7 simultaneously.

SEED: not exercised by dummy. Experience-anchored: working foundation in place; build without re-teaching basics. Cognitive demand: analysis and evaluation. Full population should verify indicativeLevels against real pathway usage.

SEED: not exercised by dummy. Experience-anchored: fluent command assumed; ready for complex, contested, self-directed use. Cognitive demand: synthesis, critique, judgement. Full population should verify indicativeLevels against real pathway usage.
